name: Siemens Energy
description: Global energy OEM whose technology underpins about one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Its SGT-A45 TR was the largest trailer-mobile package at its 2017 launch; it no longer appears in the current aeroderivative lineup (SGT-A65, SGT-A35, SGT-A05).

sources.note: Siemens Energy gas turbine portfolio page, read 26 October 2026

notes: Siemens Gamesa is the group's wind business; it is listed as a separate vendor record.
